title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0145
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0145
Multiple Vulnerabilities in Veeam Backup & Replication
Original Issue Date:March     18, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2.4165 and all earlier version 12 builds.
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in Veeam Backup & Replication which could be exploited by an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code, bypass security restrictions and gain elevated privileges on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
Enterprises and Large Organizations, cloud service providers using Veeam products.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for remote code execution, file manipulation, authentication bypass and privilege escalation.
Description
Veeam Backup & Replication is a data protection solution that provides backup, recovery, and replication capabilities.
Multiple vulnerabilities exist in the Veeam Backup & Replication product which could be allow any user who is part of the local users group or any domain user to exploit the flaws.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, bypass restrictions, manipulate files on the backup repository, or gain elevated privileges on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply appropriate software updates as mentioned in the Veeam security advisories:
https://www.veeam.com/kb4830

https://www.veeam.com/kb4830
